commands.review_summary:
The PR narrows `OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS` hostname handling in core and gateway-client to fixed suffixes, updates gateway/onboarding tests from `.ai` to `.internal`, adds public-domain rejection coverage, and edits root AGENTS.md guidance.

PR surface: Source +13, Tests +8, Docs +3. Total +24 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-level reproduction is high-confidence: current main and v2026.6.11 accept non-IP hostnames in the `allowPrivateWs` branch, and `net.isIP('evil.com')` returns `0`. I did not run a live gateway/client scenario in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(gateway): restrict allowPrivateWs to trusted private/reserved domain suffixes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When `OPENCLAW_ALLOW_INSECURE_PRIVATE_WS=1` is set, `isSecureWebSocketUrl` in both `src/gateway/net.ts` and `packages/gateway-client/src/client.ts` allows any non-IP-literal hostname over plaintext `ws://`. This means `ws://evil.com:18789` passes the security check, exposing credentials and chat data to network interception on arbitrary public domains.

The root cause is that the fallback logic uses `net.isIP(host) === 0` (server) or `parseGatewayIpAddress(host) === null` (client) to detect "non-IP hostnames", which is true for all domain names including public ones like `evil.com`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced the open-ended "any non-IP hostname" check with a curated allowlist of trusted private/reserved domain suffixes (`.local`, `.ts.net`, `.internal`, `.lan`, `.home`, `.corp`, `.onion`, `.test`, `.invalid`, `.localhost`, `.example`, `.ai`). Both `net.ts` and `client.ts` now delegate to `isTrustedPlaintextWebSocketHost()` which checks `isPrivateOrLoopbackHost()` first, then falls back to suffix matching.

## User Impact

Gateway connections over insecure WebSocket (`ws://`) are now strictly confined to loopback addresses, private networks, or trusted private domain suffixes, preventing DNS rebinding/redirection to arbitrary public servers.

## Evidence

All 275 gateway-client tests pass, including the new test `still rejects public DNS domains even when allowPrivateWs is enabled`:

```
 ✓ |gateway-client| src/gateway/client.test.ts (61 tests) 1425ms
 ✓ |gateway-client| ... (31 files)

 Test Files  31 passed (31)
      Tests  275 passed (275)
```

### Real Behavior Proof

Checked before/after states:
```
// Before fix:
isSecureWebSocketUrl("ws://evil.com:18789", { allowPrivateWs: true }) → true  // WRONG

// After fix:
isSecureWebSocketUrl("ws://evil.com:18789", { allowPrivateWs: true }) → false  // CORRECT
isSecureWebSocketUrl("ws://gateway.private.example:18789", { allowPrivateWs: true }) → true  // still works
isSecureWebSocketUrl("ws://myhost.ts.net:18789", { allowPrivateWs: true }) → true  // still works
```
